title: The type '…' can be included in the superclass constraints only once.
summary: Try removing all except one occurrence of the type name.
message_templates: The type '{}' can be included in the superclass constraints only once.

title: Unnecessary use of an abstract class.
summary: Try making '…' a top-level function and removing the class. Its category is effectiveDart, languageFeatureUsage, style. It is stable since Dart 2.0. The Dart team deprecated it in Dart 3.13.
message_templates: Unnecessary use of an abstract class.

title: Don't throw instances of classes that don't extend either 'Exception' or 'Error'.
summary: Try throwing a different class of object. Its category is style. It is stable since Dart 2.0.
message_templates: Don't throw instances of classes that don't extend either 'Exception' or 'Error'.
